nodes.description: Private mapping(address=>uint256) _balances tracking token balances in ERC20.
Private nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) _allowances tracking spending approvals.
Private uint256 _totalSupply holding total minted token supply.
Private string _name, token name set in constructor.
Private string _symbol, token symbol set in constructor.
Private uint8 _decimals, initialized to 18.
MercuryCoin constructor: calls ERC20('MercuryCoin','MRC') and mints 10000000e18 to msg.sender.
Public transfer(recipient,amount) forwarding to _transfer(_msgSender(),recipient,amount).
Public transferFrom(sender,recipient,amount) calling _transfer and reducing allowance via _approve.
Public approve(spender,amount) forwarding to _approve(_msgSender(),spender,amount).
Internal _transfer(sender,recipient,amount) updating _balances with SafeMath sub/add and emitting Transfer.
Internal _mint(account,amount) increasing _totalSupply and _balances, emitting Transfer.
Internal _burn(account,amount) decreasing _balances and _totalSupply, emitting Transfer.
Internal _approve(owner,spender,amount) writing _allowances and emitting Approval.
Public increaseAllowance(spender,addedValue) adding to caller's allowance via _approve.
Public decreaseAllowance(spender,subtractedValue) subtracting from caller's allowance via _approve.
Context._msgSender() returning payable(msg.sender).
Address.sendValue(recipient,amount) performs a low-level call forwarding ether to an arbitrary recipient.
Address._functionCallWithValue(target,data,weiValue,errorMessage) performs an unchecked low-level call{value} to target.
msg.sender, caller-controlled address used for minting, transfers and approvals.
Low-level recipient.call{value:amount}('') in Address.sendValue, external call to attacker-influenced address.
Low-level target.call{value:weiValue}(data) in Address._functionCallWithValue, arbitrary external call.
string memory name parameter of the ERC20/MercuryCoin constructor.
string memory symbol parameter of the ERC20/MercuryCoin constructor.
address recipient parameter of transfer().
uint256 amount parameter of transfer().
address sender parameter of transferFrom().
address recipient parameter of transferFrom().
uint256 amount parameter of transferFrom().
address spender parameter of approve().
uint256 amount parameter of approve().

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by _msgSender() and flows into all caller-identity logic.
Constructor mints initial supply to msg.sender, making the deployer balance caller-controlled.
transfer uses _msgSender() (msg.sender) as the sender of funds.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
Constructor invokes _mint to create the initial token supply.
transfer delegates execution to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spent allowance.
approve delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance delegates the allowance write to _approve.
decreaseAllowance delegates the allowance write to _approve.
_transfer reads _balances[sender] and _balances[recipient] before updating them.
_transfer writes the decremented and incremented balances back into _balances.
_approve writes the new allowance value into _allowances[owner][spender].
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][spender] to validate and subtract the spent amount.
increaseAllowance reads the current allowance from _allowances before adding.
decreaseAllowance reads the current allowance from _allowances before subtracting.
_mint adds to _totalSupply; supply accounting depends on SafeMath add.
_mint credits the minted amount to _balances[account].
_burn subtracts from _balances[account]; balance accounting depends on SafeMath sub.
_burn subtracts from _totalSupply; supply accounting depends on SafeMath sub.
_transfer emits Transfer events that are the observable supply/balance delta state.
sendValue executes a low-level call{value} to an arbitrary recipient, enabling reentrancy on the recipient contract.
_functionCallWithValue executes a low-level target.call{value}(data) on an arbitrary target, enabling reentrant callback.
The low-level call transfers control to the recipient which may re-enter sendValue's caller.
The low-level call transfers control to target which may re-enter the calling contract.
Constructor name parameter is assigned to state variable _name.
Constructor symbol parameter is assigned to state variable _symbol.
transfer recipient parameter flows into _transfer as the destination address.
transfer amount parameter flows into _transfer as the moved value.
transferFrom sender parameter flows into _transfer as the source address.
transferFrom recipient parameter flows into _transfer as the destination address.
transferFrom amount parameter flows into _transfer and the allowance subtraction.
approve spender parameter flows into _approve as the allowance spender.
approve amount parameter flows into _approve as the allowance value.
